curation.notes: AFM single-molecule force-clamp mechanochemistry: an (Ig27 E24C–K55C)8 titin polyprotein with buried engineered disulfides is unfolded at 150 pN, then disulfide reduction by sulfite or thiosulfate (250 mM, pH 7.5) is monitored at 250–450 pN; force-quench pulse protocols probe reversibility (S-thiosulfonation). Complemented by DFT and Ellman's colorimetric assays. Provided text is the main article (no separate methods; instrument details absent).
